criteria: Six exact imported token/type boundaries across chip, owned tab-link base and tab-link wrapper; independent original constructors/getters, authentic public minimum types and runtime token/Injector contracts.

reviews.decision: The exact value import binds only the optional constructor Inject decorator to the stable public Material token at both advertised minima. Its public namespace supplies a genuine Angular InjectionToken, not a new token with the same description. Real public Injector providers prove inherited object identity, child override, explicit null, absent optional lookup and non-equivalence of a lookalike token. The complete chip constructor equals the independently authenticated untouched16 constructor and retains the exact supplied options object or a fresh empty default. The renderer protocol receives this chip as target and the original element/zone/platform arguments. These explicit factory providers do not stand in for Angular compiled component factories or node DI.

This public interface import has exactly two erased references: the constructor null union and the rippleConfig intersection. Removing only the named type import produces identical executable JavaScript. Both minimum public declaration routes retain the exact optional historical disabled, animation enter/exit duration and terminateOnPointerUp fields; namespace is a current optional string extension and remains opaque data in owned construction. Strict declaration compilation checks both assignment directions, partial durations and six invalid configurations per subject. Complete original/candidate construction and unchanged disabled getters preserve options identity, no-op disabling and local disable gates; chips do not mutate supplied options. This admits the finite imported type/configuration boundary only, not full renderer behavior or component/consumer qualification.

The owned tab-link base uses the genuine stable public ripple token only in its optional constructor decorator. Public Injector inheritance and child override pass the same provider object to the actual complete owned base construction; absent and explicit-null providers get per-instance defaults, and same-description tokens cannot substitute. The full emitted construction matches untouched16 including parameter/field initialization except the separately enumerated existing legacy id suffix. NoopAnimations retains the historical in-place overwrite of the supplied object animation with zero durations. The disabled getter retains global, local and parent-nav gates. This source import/token boundary does not qualify Angular compiled node factories, browser behavior or the complete tab component.

The owned base has exactly two structural type references, in its constructor null union and rippleConfig intersection, and the named interface import erases without changing executable output. Authenticated public declarations at both minima preserve every historical optional field and duration type, with the explicit current-only optional namespace extension. The original construction/getter oracle and actual candidate phase agree across default, disabled, partial/custom duration, termination, opaque namespace and animation-mode cases. In particular the existing NoopAnimations branch mutates the caller options animation object field in place, as untouched16 did; no copy or immutable-options guarantee is invented. Renderer lifecycle, actual component factories, packed/native execution and advertised consumer/compiler/runtime floors remain independently pending.

The subclass token import occurs only in its optional Inject decorator and resolves to the genuine public Material token on both minimum peer lines. The complete constructor equals the authentic16 published constructor: the exact options object is forwarded in the same super argument slot, then the owned ripple renderer receives the same target, zone, element and platform arguments. Public Injector fixtures prove inherited/overridden/absent/null/lookalike provider behavior through this complete construction, including inherited base no-op semantics. Source and semantic controls reject cloned forwarding, dropped optionality and token escape. Explicit public factory providers do not establish Angular legacy compiled factory/node-DI equivalence.

The wrapper imports the stable public interface for a single erased constructor parameter type, RippleGlobalOptions or null. Removing this named type import preserves identical executable JavaScript. The full constructor and inherited base constructor/getter oracle preserve the supplied object and its historical disabled/animation/termination semantics without translating the current namespace extension. Both minimum public types are authenticated and compile with the exact owned animation/configuration shape, while invalid duration/disabled/termination/namespace values are rejected. Only this finite public type and forwarding boundary is admitted; no current ripple-loader namespace support, full renderer behavior, packed/component/AOT/browser or full floor qualification is claimed.
